headline: OPay US IPO Stalled by Chinese Regulatory Inquiry
summary: Fintech firm OPay faced a last-minute regulatory inquiry from China, casting doubt on its planned $304 million NYSE listing. The company had previously indicated it did not expect to require Chinese regulatory approval for the offering.
why: OPay is a major fintech provider in Africa; its ability to access international capital markets is crucial for its expansion and valuation.

impacts.name: OPay
impacts.why: Regulatory hurdles delay or threaten the success of planned capital raising activities.
